g.text: A0 → B0 reads: B may start entering W1 only after A has finished

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: leaving W1. Both are scheduled at t = 0 in the plan (B 'follows' A),

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: but if A is late, B now waits for it instead of driving into A's rear.
